name: scania_marine_diesel_handbook
title: Scania DI09/DI16 marine diesel engines - data-handbook analysis
summary: Coherence check and full analysis of one of four Scania marine diesel engines selected from its 2013 data handbook ($IF branches): swept volume, compression ratio, mean effective pressure, torque, fuel flow, thermal efficiency, excess air (C12H26), exhaust flow, thermal balance, volumetric and compressor isentropic efficiencies, ISO 3046/1-type derating to Lake Victoria and CO2 emissions per km.

origin.course: Moteurs à combustion interne (MCI, ULiège), June 2017 exam, instructor solution (NGEN unit); published as an example

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of RESOLUTION_NGEN.EES (compare_solution.py): '74 common variables, 10 differ (rtol=0.001)'. 6 differences are the absolute Air h/s reference-state offsets (+125.9 kJ/kg, +1815 J/kg-K), 3 are derived differences (w_cp, w_s_cp, epsilon_s_cp, max 2.2e-3), and v_bateau/Em_CO2 differ by the documented x3600 correction of a genuine unit error of the original.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of RESOLUTION_NGEN.EES (79 variables), via CoolSolve tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: max_rel_diff = 3.18e-01 as printed, on the absolute s_a_su_cp (Air reference-state offset); all derived results within 8.3e-4; thermal balance closes at 1.52 %.
